title: Optimizer Update Available
release_notes:
• Resolved ANR and page-switch stuttering with instant app model caching and decoupled network probes
• Redesigned Battery Optimization with clean right-aligned toggle switch: seamlessly manages Android DeviceIdle whitelist and background execution
• Removed app info action from battery optimization list for clean UI
• Advanced Network Optimization profiles with kernel TCP sysctl tuning (BBR/cubic, Fast Open, buffer scaling) and hardware low-latency Wi-Fi locks
